say:3:1220354001:0.text: Mr. Tucker didn't come. Why don't you want to see him?
say:3:1220354001:0.source_cn: 塔克先生没有来，你果然不想见他，为什么呢？

say:4:1220354002:1.text: Mr. Tucker is a very nice man. He's the only person in Rustport who's kind to me.
say:4:1220354002:1.source_cn: 塔克叔叔是很温柔的人，在锈锚港……只有他对我好。

say:5:1220354003:0.text: I tasted biscuits because of him. I was so hungry that I prayed to the gods. Then Mr. Tucker showed up... The gods must've sent him to save me.
say:5:1220354003:0.source_cn: 他让我知道了面包的味道，我向神明祈求不再饿肚子，来的是...

say:6:1220354004:0.text: That's why I was so scared... I didn't want him to see me become a monster...
say:6:1220354004:0.source_cn: 所以我很害怕……我不想让他看见自己变成怪物……

choice_prompt:7:1220354004.text: That's why I was so scared... I didn't want him to see me become a monster...
choice_prompt:7:1220354004.source_cn: 所以我很害怕……我不想让他看见自己变成怪物……

say:8:1220354005:0.text: Don't try and comfort me... I know what's going to happen. I'm ready for it...
say:8:1220354005:0.source_cn: 不用安慰我……这是躲不掉的命运，我也，准备好了……
say:8:1220354005:0.male: Don't try and comfort me... I know what's going to happen. I'm ready for it...
say:8:1220354005:0.female: Don't try and comfort me... I know what's going to happen. I'm ready for it...

say:9:1220354007:0.text: A few of us orphan kids were hungry, so we went to the river to try and catch a fish.
say:9:1220354007:0.source_cn: 那天我们太饿了，几个小伙伴想一起去河里抓鱼。
say:9:1220354007:0.male: A few of us orphan kids were hungry, so we went to the river to try and catch a fish.
say:9:1220354007:0.female: A few of us orphan kids were hungry, so we went to the river to try and catch a fish.

say:10:1220354008:1.text: The fishermen wouldn't let us fish near the Rustport harbor. They said that the fish belonged to them, so we went farther away.
say:10:1220354008:1.source_cn: 渔民叔叔不让我们在锈锚港附近捕鱼，那些鱼属于他们，所以...
say:10:1220354008:1.male: The fishermen wouldn't let us fish near the Rustport harbor. They said that the fish belonged to them, so we went farther away.
say:10:1220354008:1.female: The fishermen wouldn't let us fish near the Rustport harbor. They said that the fish belonged to them, so we went farther away.

say:11:1220354009:1.text: I usually have bad luck, and that day wasn't any different. When we were fishing, a group of Water Wights showed up.
say:11:1220354009:1.source_cn: 我的运气一直都很不好……那天也不例外，钓鱼的时候遇到了...
say:11:1220354009:1.male: I usually have bad luck, and that day wasn't any different. When we were fishing, a group of Water Wights showed up.
say:11:1220354009:1.female: I usually have bad luck, and that day wasn't any different. When we were fishing, a group of Water Wights showed up.

say:12:1220354010:0.text: The others were able to escape, but I was caught and taken to a very scary person...
say:12:1220354010:0.source_cn: 其他人逃走了，只有我被抓住，带到了一个很可怕的人面前！
say:12:1220354010:0.male: The others were able to escape, but I was caught and taken to a very scary person...
say:12:1220354010:0.female: The others were able to escape, but I was caught and taken to a very scary person...

choice_prompt:13:1220354010.text: The others were able to escape, but I was caught and taken to a very scary person...
choice_prompt:13:1220354010.source_cn: 其他人逃走了，只有我被抓住，带到了一个很可怕的人面前！
choice_prompt:13:1220354010.male: The others were able to escape, but I was caught and taken to a very scary person...
choice_prompt:13:1220354010.female: The others were able to escape, but I was caught and taken to a very scary person...

say:15:1220354011:0.text: His eyes were green and glowing!
say:15:1220354011:0.source_cn: 他的眼睛是绿色的……还发着光！
say:15:1220354011:0.male: His eyes were green and glowing!
say:15:1220354011:0.female: His eyes were green and glowing!

say:17:1220354015:1.text: The scary man said he could heal my scars.
say:17:1220354015:1.source_cn: 那个可怕的人说，能帮我治好身上的疤痕。

say:18:1220354016:1.text: Every couple of days, he would force me to drink a jar of sticky green slime. It tasted bitter and had a very fishy smell. It smelled worse than the sewers here.
say:18:1220354016:1.source_cn: 每隔几天，他都会逼我喝下一罐粘稠的绿色液体，很苦……非...

say:19:1220354017:0.text: But the scars on my body started to heal day by day, and finally, they all disappeared.
say:19:1220354017:0.source_cn: 但是，我身上的伤疤，竟然真的一天天好了起来，最后完全消失了。

say:20:1220354018:0.text: Was he a good person then?

say:21:1220354019:1.text: If it wasn't for that <style="stress">incident</style>, I would've thought he was a good person too.
say:21:1220354019:1.source_cn: 如果不是发生了<style=stress>那件事</s...

say:22:1220354020:1.text: The guards were not there one day, so I tried to escape, but I accidentally knocked over a big rock and it fell on my foot.
say:22:1220354020:1.source_cn: 那天看守都不在，我想逃跑，却不小心被石头砸伤了脚。

say:23:1220354021:0.text: During this time, several mice crawled over and licked at my wounds. They must've been starving or something.
say:23:1220354021:0.source_cn: 这时候几只老鼠爬过来，舔我的伤口。它们……好像饿疯了。

say:24:1220354022:1.text: Was this when you discovered that you could control the rats?
say:24:1220354022:1.source_cn: 我好像猜到了……是不是从那时候起，你发现自己可以控制老鼠？

say:25:1220354023:0.text: Yes... With their help, I was finally able to escape from that terrible cave.
say:25:1220354023:0.source_cn: 是的……在它们的帮助下，我终于逃离了那个可怕的山洞。

say:26:1220354024:1.text: In stories, princesses are often protected by small animals. I thought... I was about to become a princess.
say:26:1220354024:1.source_cn: 在故事里，公主不是常常被小动物保护吗？我以为……自己差...

say:27:1220354025:0.text: But after returning to Rustport, I found that the mice were getting bigger and bigger. They had become monsters in the end...
say:27:1220354025:0.source_cn: 可是回到锈锚港以后，我发现老鼠们越来越大。它们……变成...

say:28:1220354026:1.text: Fortunately, you were able to control the rats and prevent more serious consequences.
say:28:1220354026:1.source_cn: 幸好你能够控制这些老鼠，才没有引发更严重的恶果。

say:30:1220354028:0.text: I discovered that the animals that ate the rats started to change. They would slowly morph into horrible-looking rats themselves! And they didn't listen to me at all!
say:30:1220354028:0.source_cn: 我发现……吃掉那些老鼠尸体的动物，血肉会像海浪一样翻涌...

say:31:1220354029:1.text: It must be the green liquid you drank earlier... It has to be some kind of magical potion.
say:31:1220354029:1.source_cn: 你之前喝下的绿色液体……恐怕是一种特殊的魔药。

say:32:1220354030:0.text: According to the stories I've read, some Graveborns were capable of using dreadful magic that could alter the flesh and blood of living beings... I didn't expect it to be true...
say:32:1220354030:0.source_cn: 书上说，有些亡灵掌握着可怕的魔法，能够改变生物的血肉之...

say:33:1220354031:0.text: I was thinking that if these new rats licked my wounds like the others, they would behave themselves and start listening to me.
say:33:1220354031:0.source_cn: 我在想，是不是只要舔了我的伤口，那些老鼠也会乖乖听话，...

say:34:1220354032:0.text: So, I tried to feed them some of my blood in the hopes that they would stop causing trouble in the city.
say:34:1220354032:0.source_cn: 所以，我尝试给它们喝自己的血，希望它们不要再去地面上作乱。

say:35:1220354033:0.text: But it didn't work... and now I can't even control myself!
say:35:1220354033:0.source_cn: 但是，不止是老鼠……我甚至无法控制我自己！

say:36:1220354034:0.text: I want to bite things... I want to destroy... I want to crawl around like a rat! I feel like I'm about to turn into a monster!
say:36:1220354034:0.source_cn: 想要撕咬……想要破坏……想要趴在地上，像老鼠一样爬行！...

say:37:1220354035:1.text: With the magister here, you won't turn into a monster! He'll definitely help you!
say:37:1220354035:1.source_cn: 有主人在，你不会变成怪物！主人能帮你！
say:37:1220354035:1.male: With the magister here, you won't turn into a monster! He'll definitely help you!
say:37:1220354035:1.female: With the magister here, you won't turn into a monster! She'll definitely help you!

say:38:1220354036:1.text: Maybe if we met earlier... but it's too late now...
say:38:1220354036:1.source_cn: 如果……能早一点……但是……现在已经……太迟了……

say:39:1220354037:0.text: I can feel... a change coming. Maybe it will be tonight when the moon sets... or tomorrow when the sun rises...
say:39:1220354037:0.source_cn: 我能感觉到……变化要来了。也许是今晚月亮落下的时候，也...

say:40:1220354038:1.text: I don't want to hurt others... After I die, I want to find Dura's embrace...
say:40:1220354038:1.source_cn: 我不想伤害别人……我想在死后，去艾雅庇护的地方……

say:43:1220354041:1.text: I don't want to become a monster... I don't want to hurt people... I don't want to hurt Mr. Tucker...
say:43:1220354041:1.source_cn: 我不想……变成怪物……去伤害别人……去伤害塔克先生！
say:43:1220354041:1.male: I don't want to become a monster... I don't want to hurt people... I don't want to hurt Mr. Tucker...
say:43:1220354041:1.female: I don't want to become a monster... I don't want to hurt people... I don't want to hurt Mr. Tucker...

say:44:1220354042:0.text: Oh, no! Her body is starting to mutate! Hold on! Don't give up!
say:44:1220354042:0.source_cn: 不好！她的身体开始变异了！坚持住……不要放弃啊！
say:44:1220354042:0.male: Oh, no! Her body is starting to mutate! Hold on! Don't give up!
say:44:1220354042:0.female: Oh, no! Her body is starting to mutate! Hold on! Don't give up!

say:45:1220354043:0.text: The nights are so cold in Rustport. I want to go somewhere warm.
say:45:1220354043:0.source_cn: 锈锚港的夜晚很冷，我想去一个温暖的地方。
say:45:1220354043:0.male: The nights are so cold in Rustport. I want to go somewhere warm.
say:45:1220354043:0.female: The nights are so cold in Rustport. I want to go somewhere warm.

say:46:1220354044:1.source_cn: 求求你们……把我送去那里吧。

choice:13:0:1.text: What did this person look like?
choice:13:0:1.male: What did this person look like?
choice:13:0:1.female: What did this person look like?

say:48:1220354013:0.text: I-I don't know. It was a dark cave... I remember there were jars filled with green slime or something.
say:48:1220354013:0.source_cn: 我……我不清楚，好像是一个阴暗的山洞里……我记得有许多...

say:49:1220354014:1.text: Dark cave... green slime... sounds like the Graveborn to me.
say:49:1220354014:1.source_cn: 阴暗……绿色……让我想到了亡灵。

choice:7:0:1.text: Oh, you're okay. You're not a monster.
choice:7:0:1.male: Oh, you're okay. You're not a monster.
choice:7:0:1.female: Oh, you're okay. You're not a monster.
